name: Icejade Creation Pillar
desc:
1 WATER Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Icejade" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY face-up on your field. When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can activate this effect; the activated effect becomes "Banish 1 card you control or in the GY". If a face-up WATER monster(s) you control leave the field by your opponent's card while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Icejade Creation Pillar" once per turn.
strings: Place 1 "Icejade" Continuous Spell/Trap face-up on your field
Change the activated effect to "Banish 1 card you control or in the GY"
Special Summon this card from your GY
